content.text: No customer-payable liquidated damages, penalties, or early-termination/minimum fees appear anywhere in the agreement.

input.quote: Except for termination for material breach as detailed in paragraph 4(b), Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement
input.rationale: The agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, early-termination fee, or minimum-fee-on-termination payable by AP, which meets the preferred position (no LDs or penalties payable by Customer). Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalt", "minimum", and "damages" return no Customer-payable stipulated-sum provision. Section 4(a) entitles Kubient only to "all fees generated during the termination period" — i.e., its revenue share actually earned during the 90-day notice period under the Section 5 revenue-sharing model (where Kubient pays AP, not the reverse) — not a stipulated sum or accelerated remaining contract value, so it is not a liquidated damages payment by AP. Section 7(a) also mutually excludes punitive and similar damages. No redline required; note only that the agreement is silent on LDs rather than expressly disclaiming them.
